・Output 1: I really appreciate all the details you guys added here. You did a very nice summary for us. However, I really thought you would be providing the actual survey results, as in, sharing the raw data that shows everyones filled out surveys and responses. You provided a summary of the results, but that isn't really the actual results and without that its hard for us to know if this was ever really done. We are also unable to see that there was 50% participation rate based on what you provided. For that we would need to see evidence of how many surveys were sent out or how many people you requested to do it, and how many ultimately participated. Please provide these details so we can see the actual surveys and the number of people participating vs didn't participate to calculate the participation rate. Not Approved.
・Please see the result. Please ensure that for confidentiality we hide the Telegram channel/Email address of the participants (as per our promise in advance). Raw data as per your request: 
・Pivot Summary: 
・Satisfaction level (96% - With interviewing process; 97% with Host's professionalism)/ 
・And 87% find the material helpful for their DRep journey
・Output 2: You provided the links to your Twitter or TG or substack which have hundreds of posts on them. I do not know which are supposed to be the extra 4 newsletters that were translated. Please provide the links for the actual translated newsletters you are referring to here so there is no confusion. I know you said these are extras but if you are doing to re-submit for output 1, might as well specify here so we can see which ones you did extra. Not Approved
